annotations.title: asksteps: save a form or funnel as an own template

description: Saves an existing form or funnel of the connected asksteps account as an own template, so new forms can start from it (asksteps_create_from_template; it is listed by asksteps_list_account_templates). Requires "forms:write". A template carries the whole structure, design and pages, but never a PDF binding — a form built from a PDF is saved without it. Forms that receive external submissions cannot be saved. The account's template quota applies: the answer is "quota_exceeded" with limit and usage when it is reached. A template has no effect on visitors; it is just a stored starting point.

category.description: A category to find it by, for example "contact". May be empty.

description.description: Short description of what the template is for. May be empty.

form_id.description: The id of the form or funnel, as returned by asksteps_list_forms.

name.description: Name of the template. Leave empty to keep the form's own name.

name: asksteps_save_as_template

note.description: One or two sentences for the user.

quotaKey.description: The limit that was reached ("templates.max"). Only on "quota_exceeded".

status.description: Outcome. One of: "created", "not_found" (no form or funnel with that id in the account, or one that cannot be a template), "quota_exceeded" (the account holds as many own templates as its plan allows), "not_connected", "error". Authorisation can also refuse before the tool runs: "plan_required" (the account's plan does not include agent access), "not_enabled" (the account owner has not switched agent access on), "permission_denied" (the connected user's role lacks the permission; the note names it), "mandate_required" (the owner has not granted a mandate for this). The note then says what the user has to do.

templateId.description: The id of the new template. Pass it to asksteps_create_from_template; it is listed by asksteps_list_account_templates.

used.description: How many own templates the account holds. Only on "quota_exceeded".

title: asksteps: save a form or funnel as an own template
